text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The moment I meet up with Vodka, she
lets out a
big sigh.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I just ran into Opera O. She said hi to
me, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
She was so cool, I couldn't help but
stare...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, she was already gone.
She
probably thinks I totally ignored
her!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I know we all leave ranks to the races.
It's not like
I have to be super polite to
upperclassman, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But if she starts thinkin' I'm some brat
who won't
even say hi back to her—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't be able to take it!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What am I even doing? I'm being so
lame...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unable to forgive herself, Vodka's mood
remains
in the dumps for quite a while
after.
